items: The treehouse's menus open when you press E (□ on a pad, a tap on touch) at the wardrobe, mirrors, shoe rack, pegs, bags, Workshop, map table, telescope and the Studio's instruments, instead of opening as you walk up; E again closes them
Whatever you can use lights up with a warm outline as you come near, with a little key showing the button over it; her decks glow too while E there starts the party
In a station's menu Space (✕ on a pad) chooses; at the map table, hold Space to sail
